description: Reviewed answer set for the six synthetic tickets; not an actual model run

classification_rules.network: Descriptions explicitly reporting VPN or DNS connectivity issues
classification_rules.email: Descriptions explicitly reporting mailbox or mail-send/receive issues
classification_rules.hardware: Descriptions explicitly reporting physical device or power/display issues
